forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: b180
+title: Focus-ring tests use EditorKit's public FocusRingBed (EditorKit ^01kgwpk, 0372da7)
+---
+EditorKit ^01kgwpk (EditorKit main 0372da7) made FocusRingBed public in EditorTestSupport. AVK's focus-ring tests mount their own bed. These files use AccentLook, RingColumn, `focus(_:in:system:by:)` or expectTheThemeAccent:
+- Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Theme/SelectionSurfaceSitesHostedTests.swift
+- Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Commands/AgentItemFocusRingHostedTests.swift
+- Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Attachments/AttachmentFocusRingHostedTests.swift
+
+API: `FocusRingBed(size:accent:appearsActive:system:content:)`, `capture()`, `ring(of:against:)` → `FocusRing` (`rows`, `pixels`, `isDrawn(in:)`), `FocusRingBed.referenceRing(size:cornerRadius:accent:)`, `defaultAccent` (.blue), `hostTint` (.red), `FocusRingBedError`.
+
+## Work
+- [ ] Bump EditorKit to 0372da7 or later.
+- [ ] Mount every focus-ring item in FocusRingBed, not in HostedViewHarness: the harness window is never shown, so real capture can't see it. Delete AVK's AccentLook, RingColumn, `focus(_:in:system:by:)` and expectTheThemeAccent, with no shims.
+- [ ] Check the corner shape by comparing `ring.rows` with `referenceRing(size:cornerRadius: EditorStyle.default.radii.l).rows`, not with old numbers. Rings are now read 1.5pt outside the scope's left edge. Check the colour with `isDrawn(in: FocusRingBed.defaultAccent)`, and the absence of a ring with `rows.isEmpty`.
+- [ ] Closures that receive a CapturedImage baseline are `@MainActor` (CapturedImage is not Sendable).
+- [ ] `swift test` is green with the test count explained. #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
